12ac9deea869734c30b508f2cbdc739475aaf33f.sourceText:
* `try`：尝试执行可能出错的代码
* `throw`：抛出异常
* `catch`：捕获并处理异常
* `std::exception`：标准异常基类
* `std::runtime_error`：常用运行时异常
* `e.what()`：获取异常信息
* 异常可以跨函数传递
* 构造函数可以抛异常
* 析构函数不要随便抛异常
* 异常处理要配合 RAII 理解
* 不要滥用异常
12ac9deea869734c30b508f2cbdc739475aaf33f.translatedText:
* `try`: Attempt to execute code that may throw an error
* `throw`: Throw an exception
* `catch`: Catch and handle exceptions
* `std::exception`: Standard exception base class
* `std::runtime_error`: Common runtime exceptions
* `e.what()`: Obtain exception information
* Exceptions can propagate across functions
* Constructors may throw exceptions
* Destructors should not throw exceptions casually
* Exception handling should be understood in conjunction with RAII
* Do not overuse exceptions
